title: FR: preserve or sync sidebar panes layout
summary: Since now in v0.6 we are able to preserve the ribbon icons across workspaces by the new setting option, and there's a sync current ribbon icon layout to all command, I wonder if we could also add the counterparts to the sidebar panes? For example, in my personal use case, the workspaces themself only represent the tabs opened in the middle, and help me switch among different projects and contexts. I have always been wishing to keep a consistent, up-to-date layout and experience across workspaces—sometimes when I redesign the workflow or enable/disable plugins, the side panes changes—But without this feature, it's quite trouble some to spread the changes over all workspaces. I had to modify saved workspaces one by one, or just delete them all and fork new workspaces from the latest layout and reopen all the tabs in each space, either of the approaches is quite tedious and frustrating. Thank you for creating and maintaining this great plugin❤️ I'd really appreciate it if you can consider this FR.
